metadata.vocabulary_note: English caption proposals from the workbook only; no sample-filing corpus, shipped sets or live schema were available. GAAP does not identify a jurisdiction; INR/Crores do not establish Ind AS. Empty policy blocks are explicit unresolved placeholders, not copied shipped blocks.

prompt: Extract only figures supported by filing citations. Keep standalone and consolidated reporting separate. Preserve reporting date, period duration, presentation currency and scale; INR and Crores are workbook defaults, not proof of filing units. Distinguish raw-material consumption from closing inventory, period charges from accumulated balances, funded borrowing from guarantees, and recognized liabilities from unprovided exposure. Do not treat unavailable as zero or calculate amounts in a citation-only answer. Source definitions identify formula/label conflicts; do not silently correct the fixed template. English captions only are authored in this draft; do not assume Ind AS or any specific GAAP jurisdiction.
